question.prompt: The harmonic mean of a set of non-zero numbers is the reciprocal of the average of the reciprocals of the numbers. What is the harmonic mean of \(1,\) \(2,\) and \(4?\)

solutions.explanation:
Follow the definition in its given order: take reciprocals, average them, then take a reciprocal again.

The reciprocals of \(1,2,4\) are \(1,\frac12,\frac14\). Their average is

\[
\frac{1+\frac12+\frac14}{3}
=\frac{\frac74}{3}=\frac7{12}.
\]

Its reciprocal is \(\boxed{\frac{12}{7}}\), choice \(\boxed{\text{C}}\).
solutions.title: Apply reciprocal-average-reciprocal definition
